items.information:
#### **This is a very beginner-friendly competition! All are welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for!**
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUwMzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--2d81b584eaed41b3bca38d74ac30447709a1944e/NCM%202025%20A1.png)
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. 

##### The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. 

New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.
There will be special prizes to honour first-timer cubers!

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.


* Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You WILL NOT be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late for the same.

We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a comfortable ambience for all the fellow cubers. 
  
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. Please bring your ID card as well. 
 


Happy cubing!

The exact building (bungalow) where this competition will be hosted is located in on the road mentioned in the address section however since it is a private residence, the exact house number will be sent out ONLY to registered competitors after their registration (including payment) is confirmed. 

Please Note: This competition does not have the 3x3 as an event. 
This competition like every other WCA competition is open for all, including 1st timers as long as they know how to solve the listed events and abide by the [WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) 
Please check the [events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietMumbai2022#competition-events) tab and the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeQuietMumbai2022#competition-schedule) tab before registering. 

All Competitors are expected to help out and volunteer when they can, and although they do not need to arrive at the venue until their first event, coming earlier to help out and run the competition smoothly would be greatly appreciated!

PS - This competition has only the Blindfolded Events and Fewest Moves. Spectators and Competitors MUST remain silent whenever anyone is competing, to allow for concentration while solving.

**Note: All 3x3x3 Multi-Blind Competitors MUST submit their cubes for scrambling at the mentioned time in the schedule.**

Check out all the TABS for more information.

items.information:
![](https://i.imgur.com/Upxb5EP.png)

Why SILENCE?

We will be trying our best to provide you all with an ambience of as much as silence and serenity as possible! Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :)

We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure.

We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it.

We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a serene ambience for all the fellow cubers. 
  
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. 
 
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.

Happy cubing!
